purpose: Schema PRIOR for the dynamic-application runtime. Hints only. Fresh rendered DOM is authoritative. Nothing here is a selector contract or a script. Read-only observation: no submit, no typing, no upload, no account.

coverage.note: Both employers mapped. React SPA; the application form is a second <form> on the posting page. Text inputs report a 0x0 bounding box (CSS layout) although the form text is rendered, so a naive visibility filter drops them — the raw controls.json keeps them with visible=false and their info.* ids. Requiredness comes from the trailing '*' in the label and 'This field is required' helper text; only the resume input and radios carry the required attribute. Google reCAPTCHA v2 anchor present; a textarea#g-recaptcha-response exists.

control_families.phone: input[type=tel]#phone with country-code button ('🇺🇸+1') and hidden input name='info-phone-e164'
control_families.react_select: input#react-select-<r>-input (Preferred Location*); options load in a portal listbox only when opened — not captured
control_families.file: input[type=file]#resume required accept pdf/docx (20 MB); #cover_letter optional; #photo accept jpeg/png (10 MB); #field-<r> custom uploads (e.g. 'Portfolio / Writing Examples'); dropzone copy 'Drag and drop files or click to upload — Supported files: .pdf & .docx, up to 20 MB'
control_families.survey_radio: div[role=radiogroup] with input[type=radio] name=radio-<r> labels Yes/No, required attr; question text + link precede (e.g. 'Please fill out the following work style survey and check yes when complete. https://go.cultureindex.com/…')
